notes.title: V.2.0.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, Campers! Hope everyone is enjoying their time in Camp Bear Ridge!

We're here to announce some updates/small hotfixes. [/p][list][*][p]​Fixed some typos. There were a lot of them...[/p][/*][*][p]​Fixed a bug making the phone call section a LOT harder than it needed to be. Sorry! Some folks were playing the game on hard mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the plant on the fourth floor during the anomaly/backrooms section. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V2.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: [p]Hey, Campers! Enjoying the Extended Demo update? We certainly hope so![/p][p][/p][p]This update introduced some bugs. We got to work on fixing those right away![/p][p][/p][h3]Phone calls[/h3][list][*][p]We cleaned up the logic in the phone call section. One mistake during the phone calls were resulting in game overs. That wasn't right. Now, players have more room to make mistakes. Not everyone can be perfect, right?[/p][/*][*][p]Added some extra sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Backrooms/anomaly mini-game[/h3][list][*][p]Some odd things were happening during the game over screens during this section. Specifically with the flashlight. That's fixed![/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up the code a bit.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Typos[/h3][list][*][p]We caught some more typos! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Playing Oliver's spooky sections should be a smoother experience. Be on the lookout for more updates, folks! We're already cooking up a new sprite. Camp Bear Ridge is about to get more interesting...[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: bug fixes and typos!
notes.notes:
Bad Summer update 1.0.1 is out! 

[b]Typos[/b]
[list]
[*] We fixed typos big and small. There were quite a few!
[*] Toned down some of the writing/big words in Jenny's chapter. Sometimes simplicity is better.
[/list]

[b]Saves[/b]
[list]
[*] Hard saves weren't possible...until now. You should all be able to properly save your games now! 
[/list]

For anyone who had trouble with the saves, we apologize for the inconvenience. Thank you for your support, campers!
